# Canonical testnet bootstrap seeds — the .onion mesh entrypoints a fresh device auto-dials for its FIRST hop,
# then auto-discovers the rest from the chain-anchored peer directory. Format: peer_id|/dns/<onion>/tcp/<port>|x_pk|ek
# NO value is ever routed to a seed, so a shared list is correct (not a value-routing single point).
#
# 2026-08-14: NO VPS (user decision) — the operator's desktop node IS the origin. This line is copied
# VERBATIM from the announce file the APP-SPAWNED origin node itself writes (~/.usdmd-node/peers/27780.peer,
# identity pinned by MONEROUSD_MESH_IDENTITY=wallet ⇒ onion 7srgbwzv…). A line copied from any other
# process's announce (a manual spawn mints a DIFFERENT identity — measured: n7zizldl…, dead the moment
# that process exits) is how the phone got stuck "joining mesh". Refresh rule: if the APP's origin prints
# `onion node up: X` with X != this line, re-copy its announce file here and rebuild — never hand-edit,
# never copy from a manually-spawned node. cons: single compiled entrypoint — the origin must be online
# for a fresh device's FIRST join (chosen topology); later joins ride the chain-anchored directory.
# 2026-09-21: the launchd origin on this Mac (org.monerousd.node, RPC 27780, onion n7zizldl…) IS the testnet
# origin now; line copied verbatim from its announce file ~/.usdmd-node/peers/27780.peer. A launch with
# MONEROUSD_LIBP2P_SEED_PEERS set still overrides it.
# 2026-11-12 (lane dcash; user: "we use no paid services. we only use this device as the first node"): the line is
# STABLE across restarts and re-geneses — the onion key (~/.usdmd-node/onion-27780.seed, ~/.usdmd-arti-27780/tor-state)
# and the ML-KEM transport key (~/.usdmd-arti-27780/mlkem-identity.key) are persisted, and a re-genesis retires only
# the chain's files (scratchpad/origin.sh). Measured today: this line == ~/.usdmd-node/seed-line-27780.txt byte for byte.
# `scratchpad/origin.sh check` re-measures it; `origin.sh up <binary>` brings the origin up and proves it again.
# A second always-on machine adds its own seed-line file here verbatim, one line per seed.
